India Government Demands Meta Compliance on Algorithms and Deepfakes

The Indian government has issued a strict directive to Meta, demanding compliance with Indian laws. Officials have sought explanations from Meta regarding algorithm changes and the handling of deepfake and fake content. The government has stated that only Indian laws will be applicable in India. Meta has acknowledged shortcomings and assured corrective measures.
